doc.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Closing talk about tonight's performance
summary: Wess talks about being tired from the previous night's performance and the band.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well, we’ve had some great insights from our guest today, and we know you have to perform tonight.
Yes. I hope it will be better than the other night. I was so tired I couldn’t —
Sounded good to me, I was there.
Well you know I’d been up all day, I got about four hours sleep and got up at 7:00 and went on, you know all day, and then 10:00 at night you’ve got to be beautiful.
Well you’ve got a good band with you, that’s nice.
